title: For continuation scenes, build each new shot by screenshotting the last frame…
content: For continuation scenes, build each new shot by screenshotting the last frame of the previous Seedance 2.0 clip and using it as the starting reference for the next shot.
tips: For continuation scenes, build each new shot by screenshotting the last frame of the previous Seedance 2.0 clip and using it as the starting reference for the next shot.
